pretreatments.description: Lab-scale shredding operation using a knife mill at low speed to reduce particle size (I-PT).
Lab-scale pulping/mixing operation aimed at favoring the extraction of organic compounds into the liquid phase, performed with water addition in a 10:1 Water content/Total Solids (TS) ratio (II-PT).

Lab-scale fine blending operation intended to alter lignocellulosic structure and create a homogeneous liquid slurry, performed with water addition in a 10:1 Water content/Total Solids (TS) ratio (III-PT).
Full-scale mechanical pretreatment using a mobile hammer mill (Noremat Valormax BA915D) for cattle manure.
Full-scale mechanical pretreatment using a fixed on-line hammer mill for cattle manure.
Full-scale mechanical pretreatment using a X-Chopper chain mill (Xergi) for a mixture of silage and cattle manure.
